title: lupinus nuttallii
intro: Lupinus nuttallii, commonly known as Nuttall's lupine, is a species of flowering plant in the lupin family. This perennial plant is native to the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico, and is known for its fragrant purple flowers and edible seeds. The seeds of Lupinus nuttallii have been reported to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to their high content of protein, fiber, and essential minerals. The bioactive constituents of Lupinus nuttallii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which may exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
